articles.title: Amazon Polly now supports voice cloning

articles.excerpt: Today, AWS announces the general availability of the open source AWS Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Rust. Rust developers can use the SDK to build resilient, long-running workflows using Lambda durable functions, to create multi-step applications like infrastructure automation, deployment rollouts with approval gates, and pipelines that call AI models and pause for human review directly in their Rust code without implementing custom progress tracking. Lambda durable functions extend Lambda's event-driven programming model with operations that checkpoint progress automatically and pause execution for up to one year when waiting on external events. With the SDK, developers write a durable function as an ordinary async Rust function that awaits each durable operation like any other future and can run independent operations concurrently. The SDK includes steps that save their results, callbacks for human-in-the-loop and agent-in-the-loop workflows, invocations of other durable functions, and timed waits. The SDK works with the Rust tools developers already use. Developers add the aws-durable-execution-sdk crate with cargo add, build with Cargo Lambda, and deploy a single binary on the provided.al2023 runtime. Before deploying, they can test complete workflows with cargo test and the SDK's LocalRunner without requiring network access or AWS credentials. To get started, see the Lambda durable functions developer guide , the Rust SDK guide , and the AWS Lambda Durable Execution…
articles.title: AWS Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Rust is now generally available

articles.excerpt: Amazon VPC Flow Logs now adds Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) metadata to flow log records. Each record identifies the pod that sent or received the traffic, along with its cluster, namespace and labels. This makes it faster to investigate security events, understand traffic patterns, and troubleshoot network issues in your EKS clusters, without running monitoring software on your nodes. Amazon EKS runs pods on Amazon EC2 instances, called nodes, and many pods can share one node's network interfaces. Previously, flow log records showed the network interface and IP address for each flow, not the pod behind it. Pods are short-lived, so by the time you investigated unexpected traffic, that IP address could belong to a different pod. To trace traffic back to the right pod, teams built custom tools or ran monitoring software on every node. Now, each record names the pod that sent or received the traffic, so one log gives you both VPC and Kubernetes context. For example, if a pod sends unexpected traffic to a database in your VPC, the record shows the pod and its namespace, even after that pod is replaced. To get started, create a flow log for your cluster's VPC or subnets, and add the EKS fields to the log format. You don't need to change your cluster or applications. The fields are available for pods on Amazon EC2 instances, including EKS Auto Mode, managed node groups and self-managed nodes, that use the Amazon VPC CNI plugin for Kubernetes. Logs go to the same…
articles.title: Amazon VPC Flow Logs now supports Amazon EKS metadata

articles.excerpt: Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors the response time and GPU use of generative AI inference endpoints by default and notifies customers when responses slow down, GPUs sit mostly idle, or a configuration falls behind. Customers run GenAI Inference Recommendations to test configurations designed to restore response time or lower cost on their recent traffic, and they see measured results before anything changes in production. The best configuration for generative AI inference endpoints changes after deployment, as traffic shifts and new serving techniques become available. An endpoint whose latency rises or whose GPUs sit idle keeps running until users complain or the bill arrives. With this launch, SageMaker AI tracks response time and GPU capacity use and checks each endpoint's configuration. It does not read customer requests or responses. Findings include slower response times, unused GPU capacity, and configuration gaps such as an older serving container, missing speculative decoding, or missing GPU kernel tuning. When a change holds across the past week or a configuration gap is found, customers receive one AWS Health notification per endpoint in the AWS Management Console. Each notification links to the SageMaker AI Agentic Experience in SageMaker Studio with the endpoint and recent traffic already filled in. Customers run Generative AI Inference Recommendations, which compares the current configuration and options on response time, traffic handled, and cost per million…
articles.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects rising response times, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your generative AI inference endpoints

articles.excerpt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports private certificate authorities (CAs) for custom OAuth 2.0 credential providers. If you already connect your agents to identity providers (IdPs) hosted in your VPC, you can now configure those connections to trust certificates issued by your own CA — including AWS Private CA, enterprise CAs, and self-signed root CAs. AgentCore Identity has supported private IdP connectivity through Amazon VPC Lattice, but until now the IdP still had to present a publicly trusted TLS certificate over that private connection. With private CA support, you store your CA certificate in AWS Secrets Manager or Amazon S3 and reference it from your credential provider configuration. AgentCore Identity uses it to verify the IdP's server certificate directly, removing the need for a publicly trusted certificate or additional infrastructure on the private network path. You can offload the compute-intensive processing required for mTLS authentication to NLB, without adding certificate logic to your backend applications. To use mTLS, create a trust store with a certificate authority (CA) certificate bundle from a CA of your choice or AWS Private Certificate Authority, and attach it to a new or existing NLB TLS listener. To block certificates you no longer trust, add one or more certificate revocation lists (CRLs) to the trust store. To admit only specific clients, add client certificate filters that match the Common Name, Organizational Unit, or the DNS name or URI in the Subject Alternative Name, such as a SPIFFE ID. You can set up mTLS with the AWS Management Console, AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), or APIs. Mutual TLS for NLB is available in all AWS commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions where NLB is available. To learn more, visit the AWS Blog and the NLB User Guide.

articles.excerpt: Imagine you're building a data agent to answer questions about an enterprise data warehouse. Ideally, you'd develop and test it against production data, but access restrictions and data sensitivity make that difficult – especially when the engineers building the agent sit outside the team that owns the data. Even with access, a live warehouse is a poor test track: Catalog descriptions are often incomplete or contradicted by institutional knowledge in docs and chat threads; there’s no verified answer key across its thousands of tables; and you can't systematically vary the complexity of the data and documents to see where the agent breaks. So teams often test on toy datasets and hope the agent holds up in production. Other disciplines test differently. Automobile designers study aerodynamics by putting a scale model in a wind tunnel, which reproduces the airflow forces that matter while ignoring surface details like paint and badges. A shape that performs well in the tunnel performs well on the road because the tunnel preserves the physical properties the shape responds to. Data agents need a wind tunnel too: a synthetic data estate (the databases, documents, and chat history where a company's knowledge lives) with the same structure and causal behavior as a real organization, while synthesizing every name, number, and document. It is designed to preserve what the agent reasons over: how tables relate, what business events create which records, where institutional knowledge…
articles.summary: Google Cloud propose de tester les agents de données d'entreprise dans un « tunnel aérodynamique » : un environnement synthétique reproduisant la structure et le comportement causal d'une organisation réelle. L'accès aux données de production est souvent restreint, et un entrepôt en direct se prête mal aux tests, notamment parce que son catalogue est incomplet et qu'il n'existe pas de corrigé vérifié. articles.excerpt: Two Canadian high-tech firms have taken a step toward challenging Elon Musk's Starlink with plans for a homegrown military satellite communications system. Dominion Dynamics has signed a $2.2-million deal with Telesat to develop Arctic-ready technology, part of a broader effort to strengthen Canadian sovereignty and develop an uncrewed combat aircraft.
articles.summary: Deux entreprises technologiques canadiennes prévoient un système national de communications par satellite pour les militaires, destiné à concurrencer Starlink dans l'Arctique. Dominion Dynamics a signé avec Telesat un contrat de 2,2 millions de dollars pour développer une technologie adaptée à l'Arctique, dans le cadre d'un effort plus large de souveraineté canadienne qui inclut aussi la mise au point d'un avion de combat sans pilote.
articles.title: Canada looks to break Starlink's grip on Arctic military communications

articles.title: Parents say this N.S. driving school ‘ghosted’ them after they paid hundreds of dollars

articles.excerpt: Parks Canada and the Canadian Armed Forces say that after "further consideration," they no longer have plans to end Operation Palaci, a long-running avalanche control program in Rogers Pass through the Selkirk Mountains in Glacier National Park.
articles.summary: Parcs Canada et les Forces armées canadiennes ont annoncé qu'elles renoncent, après un nouvel examen, à mettre fin à l'opération Palaci. Ce programme de longue date vise à déclencher des avalanches au col Rogers, dans les monts Selkirk du parc national des Glaciers, en Colombie-Britannique, à l'aide d'obusiers.
articles.title: Canadian military will keep firing howitzers to trigger B.C. avalanches, pausing plan to end program

articles.title: Large AI companies 'desperate for compute' are crowding out Canadian startups at home

articles.title: Granby Zoo offers to rehome bat colony living in Quebec long-term care facility

articles.summary: Le procès de Melody Bryant, présumée complice de la fusillade de Tumbler Ridge, a été reporté du mois prochain à décembre 2027. Elle a renoncé à son droit à un procès rapide et a demandé plus de temps pour examiner la preuve communiquée par la poursuite.
articles.title: Alleged co-conspirator in Tumbler Ridge shooting has trial delayed until December 2027

digest.text: Anthropic a levé 93,5 G$ lors d'une introduction en Bourse record, au lendemain de laquelle le Nasdaq a perdu plus de 3 %. Les craintes liées à l'IA, dont un scandale touchant Nvidia, ont aussi entraîné le bitcoin à la baisse.
Broadcom a corrigé une faille critique de VMware vCenter, exploitée comme zero-day depuis septembre par un groupe lié à la Chine. Les organisations doivent appliquer les correctifs rapidement.

Plusieurs failles critiques touchent des équipements d'infrastructure : F5 BIG-IP, Cisco Expressway (exploitée activement), nginx et Drupal. SonicWall n'offrira plus de correctifs pour ses pare-feu Gen 6, ce qui force leur remplacement.

Des attaquants ont utilisé des agents d'IA autonomes pour trouver et exploiter un zero-day. Le logiciel malveillant Bazuka intègre aussi un modèle de langage, ce qui illustre l'IA comme outil offensif.

Chase, Visa et Mastercard ont confirmé des cyberattaques visant des tiers, et une fuite chez un fournisseur a exposé des données de clients de J.P. Morgan Chase. N-able a aussi subi une panne majeure après une intrusion.

Un sommet à Shenzhen a réuni Xi, Poutine et Trump. Mark Carney y a condamné l'invasion de l'Ukraine, et Trump a menacé de taxer les entreprises américaines bâtissant des centres de données à l'étranger.
Le budget du gouvernement Carney est adopté aux Communes. Le ministre Champagne dit qu'il répond à une période d'incertitude.
